workflow.name: Triage with a typed handoff
workflow.description: A triage stage returns typed JSON; a guard reads it to decide whether the fix runs; the report reads fields of both.

prompts.label: triage
prompts.text:
Triage this bug report. Find the files involved.
{{variables.bug_report}}

output.instructions: severity: how bad it is for users; files: repository-relative paths.

prompts.label: fix
report
prompts.text:
Report on the bug ({{stages.triage.output.severity}}): {{stages.triage.output.summary}}
{{#if stages.fix.summary}}Fix: {{stages.fix.summary}}{{else}}No fix was attempted (severity below high).{{/if}}
